description: Java entity class representing system notifications, including fields for key, value, associated merchant store, user, start and end dates, and audit information.

classes.name: SystemNotification
classes.description: Entity class for system notifications with fields for key, value, merchant store, user, start/end dates, and audit info.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the notification.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the notification.

methods.name: setStartDate

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the notification.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
